sections.title: Architecture
sections.content: Evidence-gated artifact DAG: Acceptance owns freeze, closure, checks, route, import, and finalization; Bootstrap produces non-authorizing semantic evidence. Default route after passing checks is deterministic_only; focused/full Bootstrap requires an explicit admitted request.

sections.title: Specification
sections.content: CAP-1 through CAP-10 require immutable identities, complete closure, real checks, controlled projection and segmentation, bounded recovery, three-role review, final evidence validation, and parity-gated rollout. Unknown, stale, incomplete, or mismatched evidence fails closed.

sections.title: Plan Index
sections.content: Delivery slices S0-S6 sequence canonical evidence, consumer migration, runtime recovery, Acceptance pipeline, projection, semantic import, and rollout. Self-hosting exception is limited and does not waive final conformant validation.

sections.title: Command Registry
sections.content: Defines fixed RED/GREEN commands for canonical evidence, migrations, runtime, Acceptance pipeline, projection, semantic import, rollout, and terminal validation. Receipts are non-authorizing.

sections.title: Implementation Contract
sections.content: Defines scoped TDD slices, dependencies, permitted paths, required command IDs, recovery behavior, and terminal implementation-complete predicate. S3/S5/S6 cover default deterministic routing, explicit request admission, finalization, and regression.

sections.title: Source Freeze
sections.content: Round-8 manifest binds selected canonical package, adopted architecture, repository rules, knowledge context, and source identities. It is non-authorizing and records no unresolved inputs.

sections.title: Repair Findings
sections.content: Round-9 P1 findings require removing inferred Bootstrap upgrades, recording machine-verifiable required-check results, and admitting optional Bootstrap only through Acceptance-owned command input.

sections.title: Repair Input
sections.content: Round-9 repair authority includes requirements, index, implementation contract, command registry, findings, repair slices, canonical specification, and architecture spine; historical acceptance evidence is excluded from rewrite.

sections.title: Repair Slices
sections.content: S3 makes default route and check outcomes machine-verifiable; S5 finalizes deterministic evidence and exact-matched requested Bootstrap evidence; S6 proves zero default Bootstrap calls and rejects forged or automatic upgrades.

sections.title: Requirements
sections.content: ARBE-001 through ARBE-022 map capabilities to slices and acceptance IDs. Required-check success selects deterministic_only; explicit focused/full requests require controlled receipt and current identity bindings; Bootstrap and advisory text cannot publish acceptance-passed.
